starting_text: "Do you have what it takes to be a Cosmo?"
"Just by looking at you... I DON'T THINK SO!"
"Come on, prove you have what it takes to wear that mask!"
All of a sudden, everything starts shaking
Lots of loud footsteps fly by overhead
"What's going on??!" Bob said louder, with some fear creeping into his voice.
There's yelling, then you hear footsteps go down the stairs. Two guys in red University of Utah t-shirts emerge from the doorway.
One of them says, "Are you guys ok? Follow us!" He motions for Bob and I to follow him.
"Hhmmmmmm..." you hear Bob say, "Something feels off here"
The other guy in the Utah shirt says, "What are you doing? Come with us!"
One of them looks a little annoyed, then they look at each other for a split second. One of them gives the other a slight nod, and then they start to walk towards us.
"${name}! Now's the time to prove yourself! I'll handle one, you get the other!
battle_tutorial: The Utah fan taunts at you as he approaches. "It was nice knowing you, Cosmo."
text_1: "You did good!" Remarked Bob, "But it still took you kind of long."
You both walk upstairs, and there's four more guys waiting for you.
"HEY, WHERE ARE THE OTHER TWO!!!???" One of them says angrily
"Bob looks at you, then says excitedly, "Round 2!"
battle_2: Two of them look at you and say, "This should be easy"
text_2: You and Bob are standing over the dead bodies of the Utah Fans.
text_3: You killed my Pikachu!" Ash yelled angrily!
battle_4: Now I'm going to kill you!
text_4: Congrats, you are the Pokemon Champion now! You have beaten the game, ${name}!
